subject: literacy
concept: Recognizing the parts of a story: characters, setting, problem, and solution
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts story-element cards (character, setting, problem, solution) after hearing a story
exercise.pictorial: Student labels pictures from a story with the correct story element
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the characters, setting, problem, and solution in a written story

misconception_flags: confuses the problem with just any event in the story

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
